AboutSection.title: Introduction to Women Empowerment Cell
descriptions: The Women Empowerment Cell (WEC) is dedicated to fostering leadership skills, raising awareness, and promoting gender equality among female students. Our mission is to create a safe and supportive environment that encourages women to actively participate in shaping society. Through various initiatives such as guest talks, awareness programmes, and welfare activities, we aim to empower women with knowledge of their social and legal rights. WEC also extends its reach to rural areas, educating women on standing against gender discrimination and violence. By instilling values, nurturing confidence, and enhancing leadership qualities, we strive to ensure the well-being and advancement of women in all spheres of life.

VMSections.title: Vision
VMSections.description: To uphold and promote women’s rights, ensure fair and safe environment and respect towards female students / teachers and supporting staff.

VMSections.title: Mission
ListPoints: To ensure protection and empowerment of women.
To provide safe and supportive environment for women community
Promoting gender equality and raising awareness about women’s issues/rights.
To promote the well-being and advancement of women in all spheres of life.

AccordionSections.title: Objectives
points: To nurture leadership skills in women community
To raise awareness about the social issues that female student encounter.
To make the women students understand their equal responsibility in building society.
To create awareness, instill values, and develop the personality and leadership qualities in the members of WEC.
To reach out to women in rural areas and make them aware of their social and legal rights and to equip them to stand against gender violence and gender discrimination.
To enable women empowerment through guest talk, awareness programmes and other welfare activities.

Sections.title: Breast Cancer Awareness
Sections.description:
As part of the Community Extension Activity under Mission Mac, students from NCMS have taken a proactive role in creating awareness about Breast Cancer. 

From November to January 2023-24, these enthusiastic students embarked on a mission to educate and engage communities in Venkatagiri Kote, Irigenahalli, and Canara Bank Rural Self Employment Training Institute, Chikkaballapur.

The initiative aimed not only to spread crucial information about Breast Cancer but also to foster a sense of community involvement and support. By actively participating in these awareness campaigns, NCMS students have made a significant impact on the well-being of individuals in these regions.

As a result of the concerted efforts during this period, the Mission Mac team has played a vital role in creating a more informed and empowered community.

Sections.title: Free Health Checkup (8.11.2023)
Sections.description:
NCMS's Sakhi Samrudhi organised a comprehensive awareness programme on breast cancer coupled with a Free Health Checkup for the women staff and guests. This impactful event took place on 8th November 2023, promoting women’s health and creating awareness about the critical issue of Breast Cancer.

Distinguished Doctors’ Team:

1. Dr. Harini R, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Nandi Medical College & Research Institute.

2. Dr. Anitha D, Consultant Obstetrician & Gynecologist, Pathi Hospital.

3. Dr. Sunitha S Murthy, Consultant Obstetrician & Gynecologist, Murthy Nursing Home.

4. Dr. Savitha Rames, Consultant Obstetrician & Gynecologist, Rajesh Clinic.

The event not only provided an opportunity for free health checkups for all the ladies but also featured insightful talks by our esteemed doctors. Their expertise shed light on crucial aspects of women’s health, with a particular focus on Breast Cancer awareness.

Sections.title: Women Reservation Policy | Ms. Prabha N Belavangala (26.10.2023)
Sections.description:
In a bid to foster informed conversations and drive societal progress, we organised a compelling guest talk on the ‘Women Reservation Policy’ on 26th October 2023. The event featured Ms. Prabha N Belavangala, a distinguished Women Activist from Bengaluru, as the resource person.

Ms. Belavangala brought her wealth of experience and expertise to the forefront, engaging the audience in a thought-provoking discussion on the Women Reservation Policy. The event aimed to deepen understanding, address concerns, and promote dialogue surrounding the crucial policy that plays a pivotal role in fostering gender equality and empowerment.

Our commitment to societal awareness and inclusivity is reflected in our choice of impactful topics and esteemed speakers. Ms. Prabha N Belavangala’s insights added significant value to the discourse, contributing to a more informed and engaged community.

4. Dr. Savitha

Sections.title: Self-Defense Session | Mr. Mohammed Zabiulla (14.12.2022)
Sections.description:
In our ongoing commitment to student well-being, NCMS Women’s Cell organised an impactful self-defense session on 14th December 2022. The event aimed to equip students with essential skills for personal safety and empowerment.

Resource Person: Mr. Mohammed Zabiulla, Martial Art Trainer

Mr. Zabiulla, a seasoned Martial Art trainer, served as the resource person, imparting practical techniques and strategies for self-defense. The session was designed to instill confidence and ensure that students are well-prepared to navigate various situations.

Sections.title: Ethics and Human Values | Mr. M R Sathya Narayan (26.12.2022)
Sections.description:
Discovering the essence of ethical living in our guest talk on ‘Ethics and Human Values,’ held on 26th December 2022. The insightful session was facilitated by the esteemed Mr. M R Sathya Narayan, an advocate at the High Court in Bengaluru.

Mr. Narayan, with his wealth of legal expertise, delved into the importance of ethics in our daily lives and the significance of upholding human values promoted ethical awareness and provided valuable insights into navigating ethical dilemmas in various aspects of life.

Sections.title: Women are the Real Architects of Society (8.3.2022)
Sections.description:
On March 08, 2022, we had the privilege of hosting an enlightening doctors talk on the empowering theme, ‘Women are the Real Architects of Society.’ This thought-provoking event featured esteemed resource persons, including:

1. Dr. Sushma S, MBBS, DGO, DNB, Gynecologist
2. Dr. Harini R, MBBS, DGO, DNB, Gynecologist
3. Dr. Anitha, MBBS, DGO, Gynecologist

Our expert panel of gynecologists shared valuable insights into the pivotal role that women play in shaping and nurturing society. The event aimed to celebrate and acknowledge the multifaceted contributions of women, emphasising their significance as the true architects of a thriving and harmonious community.
